summary: Iteration 13 — validated NEW admin full CRUD (create/edit/permanent delete) end-to-end. Backend: added TestAdminFullCRUD (8 tests) covering POST /api/admin/points create with full payload + defaults + invalid coords 400 + missing lat/lng 422 + non-admin 403 + unauth 401, PUT on custom point, DELETE permanent for custom (verified 404 on re-delete and listing exclusion), also added test_admin_delete_permanent_on_static_point on pt-01000. Adjusted TestAdminPointOverrides + TestAdminPartial teardown to use direct Mongo cleanup (delete is now permanent so HTTP DELETE can't reset). Skipped cust-* points in TestCarriersList invariants (they can legitimately violate locker=1-carrier rule). Frontend: full 14-step Playwright flow — guest cannot see admin-add-point-btn nor detail-edit-btn; admin login → add-btn visible → open form → fill all fields (name/type locker/carrier chronopost/address/postal/city/phone/lat/lng/hours) → save → toast + form closes + detail modal auto-opens on new point → edit-btn present → open edit → form pre-filled with 'Éditer le point' title → modify name+coords+save → detail refreshed → open edit again → delete-btn → confirm → confirm-btn → toast 'Point relais supprimé' + form closes + point removed from list → regression: search/suggest still works → logout → guest again cannot see edit btn. Backend 72 passed / 6 skipped (external Overpass/Nominatim) / 0 failed. Final Mongo state clean (0 overrides, 0 deleted, 0 custom).

minor.issue: get_point() does not check _DELETED set — a permanently-deleted static point still returns 200 on the single-point endpoint (listing /api/points correctly excludes it). No functional impact today (frontend never fetches by id, always via listing/state), but inconsistent with delete semantics.

action_items: OPTIONAL/minor: In backend/server.py get_point(), also check `point_id not in _DELETED` to keep single-point endpoint consistent with listing after a permanent delete. Current UI flow doesn't hit this path so not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:652-657 GET /api/points/{id} doesn't honor _DELETED set — a deleted static point still returns 200 on this endpoint while /api/points hides it. Consider adding `if p['id'] in _DELETED: raise HTTPException(404)` to /api/points/{id} for consistency.
server.py:286-290 _validate_coords bounds (lat 41–51.5, lng -5.8–9.8) are correctly enforced on both POST and PUT; nice.

server.py:357 pid = f'cust-{secrets.token_hex(6)}' — 12 hex chars = 48 bits of entropy, low collision risk for the expected admin usage. If ever exposed publicly for enumeration hardening, consider token_urlsafe(9).

server.py:409-417 admin_update_point handles the branch 'point_id in _CUSTOM' via full replace + upsert — good. Note that when carrier changes and no new carriers list is provided, `pt.setdefault('carriers', [fields['carrier']])` will only fall back if the key is absent; if the point had carriers=['x','y'] and admin updates only carrier=z, carriers remains ['x','y'] (z not necessarily included). Minor edge case — the frontend form always sends both carrier and carriers together so no user-facing bug.
server.py:428-441 admin_delete_point permanently removes; matches spec. It also deletes any override for the same id — good.

server.py:684-711 startup loads _OVERRIDES/_CUSTOM/_DELETED from Mongo — good. However any mutation while backend is running is in-memory-only until restart in the sense that another backend instance wouldn't see them until reload. Not blocking for single-instance deploy.
PointForm.js:56 carrierList logic (`carriers.includes(carrier) ? carriers : [carrier, ...carriers]`) correctly ensures the primary carrier appears in the handled list — good.

PointForm.js:41 confirmDelete state doesn't reset when the modal is closed and reopened via edit; a user who cancelled delete then closed the form and re-edited may or may not see the confirm panel state — actually confirmDelete is component-local state that gets re-created on every mount (point key changes), so it's fine.

MapApp.js:704-725 PointForm rendered only when formPoint !== undefined — good. But state ordering means if selected exists AND formPoint is defined, PointDetail is hidden — intended UX (form takes over) — good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin full CRUD works end-to-end. Backend endpoints: POST /api/admin/points (PointFullIn, requires lat+lng), PUT /api/admin/points/{id} (PointPatchIn, all fields optional), DELETE /api/admin/points/{id} — permanent for both cust-* and static. Custom points stored in db.custom_points (id='cust-<12hex>'), overrides in db.point_overrides, tombstones in db.deleted_points. In-memory dicts _CUSTOM/_OVERRIDES/_DELETED are loaded at startup and mutated by admin endpoints; direct-Mongo cleanup during tests requires backend restart to reflect in-memory (session-safe workaround: only test on pt-01000 for static delete and don't restart in parallel). Frontend testids: admin-add-point-btn (top-right, admin only), point-form, point-form-title, point-form-close, form-name, form-type-relais/locker, form-carrier (select), form-carrier-chip-<id> (multi-select chips), form-carriers (wrapper), form-address, form-postal, form-city, form-phone, form-lat, form-lng, form-hours-lunven/sam/dim, form-save-btn, form-delete-btn (edit only), form-delete-confirm + form-delete-confirm-btn, detail-edit-btn (admin only in PointDetail). Minor known issue: GET /api/points/{id} doesn't check _DELETED (see action_items). Overpass/Nominatim geocoding external tests were skipped due to rate limits — not related to this feature.
rca_of_the_issue: No user-facing bug found for this feature. Previous iteration reported backend crash (NameError PointFullIn/PointPatchIn) was already fixed by main agent; this iteration confirmed models are defined (server.py:72-96) and endpoints operate correctly.
